reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 12 (p0086) gives an express warranty that the Software will conform to the Specifications in all material respects for the acceptance period, one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter while Maintenance Services continue — at or above the preferred 12-month software warranty measured against a documented standard.

A real remedy exists: no-charge Software Repair Service (p0077) and rejection with return of all amounts paid during acceptance (p0053/p0057); Section 15 (p0105) preserves direct damages rather than making repair the sole remedy.
No 'AS IS' or implied-warranty disclaimer is present, so the walk-away condition (disclaimer swallowing the express warranty) does not apply; the deterministic period check passes.
Correctly no redline and no comment for a compliant finding — the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs.

Gaps versus the preferred wording (no separate professional/workmanlike services warranty, no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty, no express escalation to replacement/refund post-acceptance) are properly noted in the rationale as sub-elements rather than raised as deviations.
